title: Preliminary geologic map of the Savannah River site, Aiken, Allendale, and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina
citation: Prowell, D.C., 1994, Preliminary geologic map of the Savannah River site, Aiken, Allendale, and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-94-181, map scale 1:48,000.
notes: USGS OF-94-181 preliminary geologic map of the Savannah River Site (Prowell, 1994), 1:48,000, outcropping Cenozoic units only; text says subsurface units and cross sections were left out. Contacts drawn from structure-contour maps of unit bases; author cautions against applying contacts far from outcrops or drill holes. Core-sample elevations (m and ft, datum not stated) are kept in interval descriptions. Griffins Landing sample is in Georgia and was left out; Clinchfield Formation is subsurface only and not described. Only drill-hole label FC3A was legible in the map-face OCR; others not itemized. SUBSURFACE: none beyond core-sample elevations.
